entities.name: Akoum Skyclave
entities.description: One of seven floating kor fortresses on Zendikar, shattered long ago and reawakened.

entities.name: Kor Empire
entities.description: Ancient empire that built the Skyclaves.

entities.name: Kargan tribes
entities.description: Akoum tribes who tamed dragons and brought down the Skyclave.

entities.name: Rise of the Skyclaves
entities.description: Reawakening of the skyclaves in 4561 AR.

entities.name: Kesenya
entities.description: Leader of the adventuring party that activated the Emeria skyclave.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: Planeswalker and lithomancer who explored the Skyclave seeking power to heal Zendikar.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Planeswalker who accompanied Nahiri, then left after disagreeing.

entities.name: Lithoform core
entities.description: Key said to unlock the power to heal Zendikar.

entities.name: Fern elemental
entities.description: Elemental summoned by Nissa that withered to ash.

events.summary: The Kargans, riding tamed dragons, shatter the Akoum Skyclave, ending Kor rule in the region.
events.quote: Their coordinated attacks ultimately succeeded in bringing down the Skyclave.

events.summary: Kesenya's party activates Emeria's defenses and the Akoum fragments levitate again.
events.quote: its fragments began levitating once again

events.summary: Nahiri and Nissa ascend the Skyclave; Nahiri quells Roil tremors.
events.quote: Their exploration was interrupted by Roil tremors, which Nahiri quelled with lithomancy.

events.summary: They defeat a felidar guardian and survive a geopede trap.
events.quote: They survived a deadly geopede trap through teamwork

events.summary: Nahiri takes the lithoform core, calming the Roil but killing the fern elemental; they fight and Nissa planeswalks away.
events.quote: Nissa chose to protect Zendikar alone and planeswalked away

relations.quote: the Kargans launched an aerial assault on the Kor fortresses
It once hovered above the mountainous continent of Akoum
